about_the_game:
Slide Together. Fish Together. Waddle Your Way.

A Game About Penguins invites you into a snug online world where you can truly live your best penguin life. Glide down sparkling ice hills, soar off frosty ramps, plunge into chilly waters, decorate your dream igloo, and gather with friends in a winter wonderland made for play, creativity, and endless discovery.

Here, progress is as laid-back as a penguin’s waddle, social spaces buzz with energy, and every play session brings a new surprise - be it a shimmering rare fish, a snazzy new outfit, or a boost to your sliding speed.

Make Your Penguin Truly Yours

Your penguin is more than just a character; it’s your frosty alter ego, gliding across the ice with your unique flair.

Mix and match colors, hats, and quirky accessories from a treasure trove of unlockables. Flaunt custom nameplates and tags to make your mark. Transform your home with furniture and layouts that reflect your style. The more you play, the more ways you’ll find to show off your penguin personality.

Whether you’re strutting through the village or snapping the perfect selfie with your Penguin Phone, style is everything in this frosty world.

Slide, Swim, and Discover

Every adventure begins with a slide! Movement is the heartbeat of penguin life. Carve your own path across snowy fields, pull off dazzling tricks, and rocket off ramps to soar skyward. Dive into shimmering waters to uncover hidden underwater realms teeming with color and life.

Cast your line and reel in adventure. Discover 98 unique fish species to log in your Fish Journal and trade for rewards. Boost your stats to zip across the ice or become a master angler, tailoring your playstyle as you go.

Meet a cast of 8 quirky NPCs and dive into a web of questlines. There’s always a new adventure calling your name.

Play, Compete, and Hang Out

The world isn’t just for exploring! It’s for sharing. Meet up in the bustling restaurant to challenge friends at minigames and arcade classics. Dive into snowball battles for a flurry of fun, use emotes to express yourself, bump into pals with wobbly physics, or just kick back and chat in warm, welcoming hangouts.

Whether you’re on the hunt for new achievements, conquering quests, topping arcade leaderboards, or simply chilling with friends, A Game About Penguins lets you carve out your own kind of fun.

Key Features

  • Online multiplayer sandbox built around social play

  • Free sliding with tricks, ramps, and stat upgrades

  • Swimming and underwater exploration

  • 98 fish species to catch and track in your Fish Journal

  • 8 unique NPCs with questlines

  • Progression system with unlockable customization items

  • 363 total market items for character customization

  • Home buying and decoration

  • Interactive restaurant with minigames and 6 arcade games

  • Structured snowball fight activities with snowball guns

  • Emote system and fun, physics-based player collision

  • Penguin Phone for photos, messaging, customization, and selling fish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel o AMD processor, 3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

  • Processor: Quad-core Intel o AMD processor, 3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: A cozy online multiplayer sandbox where you live as a customizable penguin. Slide, fish, swim underwater, decorate your home, complete quests, and hang out with friends in a snowy world full of minigames and social fun.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
